name: ExpenseTracker
tagline: Native Android expense tracker with budgeting, analytics, and bill-splitting
summary: A native Android app built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for tracking expenses, managing budgets, viewing spend analytics, and splitting bills between people, backed by a local Room database using an MVVM architecture.

notableDecisions: Manual dependency wiring via ViewModelFactory classes instead of a DI framework like Hilt, to keep scope simple.
Fully offline-first: all data persisted locally via Room, no remote backend/sync in this version.
Custom Compose Canvas-based pie chart (StatsPieChart) for category-wise spend visualization.

keyFeatures: Spend analytics with pie chart visualization

challenges.title: Kotlin / Compose Compiler version mismatch
challenges.description: Build failures traced to the Compose Compiler being tightly version-pinned to a specific Kotlin version; resolved by bumping Kotlin from 1.9.22 to 1.9.23 to match Compose Compiler 1.5.11.

challenges.title: AAR metadata check failures
challenges.description: Hit a ':app:checkDebugAarMetadata FAILED' task, typically caused by a dependency's AAR being compiled against a newer Android API level than the project's compileSdk; diagnosed via Gradle debug output and resolved by aligning SDK/dependency versions.
